# MKS’ Atotech to showcase sustainable paint support technologies at FABTECH 2026


**Berlin, October 13, 2026 –** MKS Inc. (NASDAQ: MKSI), a global provider of enabling technologies that transform our world, will participate in FABTECH 2026, North America’s premier event for metal forming, fabricating, welding, and finishing professionals. The exhibition will take place from October 21–23, 2026, at the Las Vegas Convention Center.


FABTECH brings together thousands of manufacturing professionals and more than 1,400 exhibitors to explore the latest developments in production technologies, automation, fabrication, welding, and finishing. The event provides an ideal platform for industry leaders to exchange knowledge, discover innovations, and identify solutions that improve operational efficiency and sustainability.


At booth **S16046 in the South Hall Lower Level** , MKS’ Atotech will highlight its portfolio of sustainable paint support technologies designed to help applicators improve operational performance, reduce operating costs, and support environmental objectives. Serving industries including automotive, commercial vehicles, appliances, aluminum wheels, construction and agricultural equipment, furniture, and architectural aluminum, the portfolio offers effective alternatives to conventional pretreatment and paint removal processes. These technologies are designed to reduce chemical consumption, extend solution life, lower waste generation, and contribute to reduced energy usage.


Featured technologies will include:


**UniPrep®‒** Long life, low temperature degreasers suitable for steel and aluminum battery components


**UniPrep® AC** ‒ A line of sustainable, near-neutral weld and laser scale removal solutions improving part quality and employee safety


**Master Remover®‒** Sustainable paint removal solutions for various paints from a multitude of metal substrates


**UniCoat® CTR** ‒ A single-step zirconium cleaner coater offering improved cleaning and enhanced paint performance


**Interlox®** – Zirconium-based conversion coatings and passivates for enhanced corrosion protection and paint adhesion


Visitors are invited to meet with MKS’ Atotech experts to learn how these technologies can support more efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective paint shop operations.


**Event:** FABTECH 2026
**Date:** October 21–23, 2026
**Booth:** S16046, South Hall Lower Level
**Venue:** Las Vegas Convention Center, Las Vegas, Nevada, USA


For more information, please visit[https://www.fabtechexpo.com/](https://www.fabtechexpo.com/) .
